description: Search reviewed historical reports and scanned-opinion derivatives, separate from primary opinion bodies. Historical editorial headnotes and the initial source notice and caption of a modern scan are excluded from search. Appended correction orders are searched as complete components, including their captions. Each result identifies its derivative type and retains source provenance, source notices and date limitations. These are not official verbatim judicial text or citator results; citation eligibility is not evaluated. case_get includes labeled components.
name: case_transcription_search
title: Search reviewed case transcriptions
